How Angelica Schuyler Church connects

  • Faction: the Schuyler sisters — Angelica is the sister who matches Hamilton's mind.

What is Angelica Schuyler Church?

Angelica Schuyler is the eldest sister who trades verses with Hamilton, reads him at speed, and steps back so Eliza can marry him — the intellectual pairing the show will not let rest.

Key threads lead to the Schuyler sisters and Alexander Hamilton.
